subject: IAM Action Required – Payments Portal (IAM-001)
body:
Subject: Request for IAM Evidence – Quarterly Access Review for Payments Portal (Ticket IAM-001)

Dear Business and Support Owners,

As part of the quarterly access review for the Payments Portal (Ticket ID: IAM-001), please provide the necessary IAM evidence to validate all active users in the AD group APP_PAYMENTS_PROD. Specifically, we require:

- Access review results  
- Confirmation of leaver deprovisioning  
- Any related ARM tickets or supporting documentation  

Kindly share the requested information at your earliest convenience to ensure compliance within the SLA timeframe.

Thank you for your cooperation.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]  
IAM Governance Analyst
